captions.detailed: A pair of image-stabilized binoculars colored entirely in matte black. It features a central rectangular prism block housing the stabilizing mechanics, connected to two large cylindrical objective barrels at the front and two smaller cylindrical eyepieces at the back. A small cylindrical focus wheel is mounted at the rear between the eyepieces, allowing for continuous rotation, while the central bridge allows for revolute adjustment of the interpupillary distance.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of image-stabilized binoculars. The model should feature a central rectangular prism block, two large cylindrical objective barrels, two smaller cylindrical eyepieces, and an adjustable central bridge with a rotatable focus wheel, all finished in a matte black material.
captions.factory: Construct the central prism block as a box primitive. Create the objective barrels and eyepieces using extruded cylinders, then hollow them out using boolean subtraction. Model the central bridge hinge using small cylindrical pins and attach a small cylinder to represent the focus wheel. Assemble the parts using a central coordinate system, assigning revolute joint limits to the hinge and continuous rotation to the focus wheel.
